verdict.rationale: The pack only glancingly shows that Slack has channels, including private channels: a community report mentions exporting 'DMs and private channels', and a help-page keyword list includes 'Add members' and 'channel management'. No first-party documentation describes creating public versus private channels or admin membership controls. Missing for 10: first-party docs on creating public/private channels, documented membership and access controls (inviting, removing, restricting who can join), admin-level channel management detail, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can organize conversations into public and private channels with membership controls

citations.quote: Corporate Export requires legal/compliance justification and Slack's approval before you can export DMs and private channels.
